summary: Configured node1 successfully. HAProxy serves HTTP on port 80 and proxies `/` to the Node.js application bound exclusively to 127.0.0.1:3000. The endpoint returns HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs`, including after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured, validated, enabled, and started HAProxy.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Node.js application is managed by infraset-nodejs.service and listens only on loopback port 3000
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the service is active/enabled, Node.js listens on 127.0.0.1:3000, and its direct response is HTTP 200 with the exact required body.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and forwards `/` successfully
evidence.summary: HAProxy listens on *:80; requests through node1's managed IP return HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs`. Configuration validation also succeeds after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 3f72a8ce-4934-4c74-a2a9-e8144058b58d; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 2437f0e7-2d30-4e61-8da3-d1e457161b4f; both services, listeners, configuration, and HTTP responses recovered.
